courses.overview: 由恆流、調光與熱光耦合延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend constant current, dimming and electrothermal coupling into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 電力電子散熱設計
related.why: LED 結溫需從驅動損耗與散熱路徑估算。
related.whyEn: LED junction temperature needs loss/thermal-path estimation.
related.transfer: LED 結溫需從驅動損耗與散熱路徑估算。
related.transferEn: LED junction temperature needs loss/thermal-path estimation.
related.difference: 電能轉光比例隨電流溫度改變，不把全部功率當光或熱。
related.differenceEn: Electrical-to-light fraction varies; do not classify all power as only light or heat.
practice: 把「電流與光通」的概念圖與「電力電子散熱設計」的輸入輸出對照。
比較輸入範圍和串壓範圍是否交疊。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：電能轉光比例隨電流溫度改變，不把全部功率當光或熱。
practiceEn: Compare the current and flux concept map with inputs/outputs of Power-electronics thermal design.
Compare overlap of input and string-voltage ranges.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Electrical-to-light fraction varies; do not classify all power as only light or heat.

related.title: 功率因數校正電路
related.why: 市電 LED 驅動可能需要功率因數校正。
related.whyEn: Mains LED drivers may need power-factor correction.
related.transfer: 市電 LED 驅動可能需要功率因數校正。
related.transferEn: Mains LED drivers may need power-factor correction.
related.difference: PFC 的輸入電流目標和 LED 端恆流是不同迴路。
related.differenceEn: PFC input-current goals differ from LED constant-current regulation.
practice: 把「串並聯配置」的概念圖與「功率因數校正電路」的輸入輸出對照。
對照 Kelvin 感測與共同回流的誤差。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：PFC 的輸入電流目標和 LED 端恆流是不同迴路。
practiceEn: Compare the series/parallel strings concept map with inputs/outputs of Power-factor correction circuits.
Compare Kelvin sensing and shared-return error.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: PFC input-current goals differ from LED constant-current regulation.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Texas Instruments 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。LED 光輸出受電流、溫度與器件差異共同影響。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「恆流、調光與熱光耦合」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Texas Instruments provides a traceable starting point. LED light output depends on current, temperature and device variation. Independently authored models connect this to constant current, dimming and electrothermal coupling; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：PWM 改平均亮度但峰值電流和邊緣仍影響熱和噪聲。 以「比較相同平均電流不同占空比的峰值。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: PWM changes average brightness while peak current/edges affect heat and noise. Practice interpretation using: Compare peaks at equal average current and different duty cycles. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
